verdict.rationale: Grok's built-in OAuth connectors and custom tools give it access to the user's own data (email, calendar, Drive, Teams, Salesforce, internal databases) right inside the chat. As an AI assistant, it reasons over that data to produce answers, and Realtime Multi-agent Research supports deeper multi-step analysis. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of insight or suggestion features (proactive recommendations, data analysis outputs) beyond search/read access, and hands-on corroboration of insight quality on users' connected data.
